meta.title: Monty IFC Viewer — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Free, open-source IFC viewer that plays back the build sequence of a BIM model step by step, with the properties of every element. For Windows, macOS and Linux.

header.label: BIM and IFC viewer
header.title: Monty IFC Viewer
header.tagline: Watch your model appear step by step, in the order it is built
header.desc: Open an IFC file, choose which parameter sets the order and play back the build sequence. Click an element for all its properties, or isolate and hide what you don't need.
header.proofLocal: Your model stays on your computer

sequence.alt: Monty IFC Viewer in the dark theme: the build sequence of a CLT model at step 7 on the Mark parameter, with the properties of a selected wall on the right
sequence.title: Play back the build
sequence.desc: Press play and the model grows step by step. What has been built is shown; what is still to come stays transparent. Pause, step back or forward and set the speed.

parameter.alt: The parameter for the order, the current step, the playback buttons, the speed and the list of values
parameter.title: You choose what sets the order
parameter.desc: Choose an IFC parameter, such as Mark. The viewer groups the elements per value, puts the values in order and shows how many elements belong to each step.

properties.alt: The properties panel of a selected wall: IFC type, material, dimensions and parameters
properties.title: Everything about one element
properties.desc: Click an element and it lights up. The panel shows the IFC type, the material, the dimensions and all parameters of that element.

models.title: Several models side by side
models.desc: Open several IFC files and switch between them with tabs. Isolate or hide elements from the context menu and reset the view with Esc.

notice.text: Local and without an account: the app reads your IFC file on your own computer. Nothing is uploaded.

features.label: Features
features.heading: An IFC model, step by step
features.sub: Start with the highlights or pick a topic.

player.title: Play and pause
player.desc: First, previous, play, next and last step, with a progress bar that counts how many elements are already visible.

parameter.title: Order by any parameter
parameter.desc: Choose which IFC parameter sets the order, with the number of unique values and elements alongside.

speed.title: Your own pace
speed.desc: Use a slider to set how long each step stays on screen.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.desc: Space, arrow keys, Home and End for the build sequence, Esc to reset the view.

open.title: Open IFC files
open.desc: Drag an IFC file into the window or pick it with the file picker.

view3d.title: 3D view
view3d.desc: Orbit, pan and zoom around the model, or zoom to the whole model in one click.

properties.title: Properties
properties.desc: IFC type, material, dimensions and parameters of the element you click.

isolate.title: Isolate and hide
isolate.desc: Use the context menu to show only the selected elements, hide them or show everything again.

tabs.title: Several models
tabs.desc: Open several IFC files at once and switch between them with tabs.

themes.title: Two languages, four themes
themes.desc: Dutch or English, in a dark, light, blue or high-contrast theme.

download.label: Download
download.title: Download v1.0.2
download.lead: Free, no account needed. For Windows, macOS and Linux.
download.metaMac: .dmg for Macs with an Apple processor
download.mobileNote: Monty IFC Viewer is a desktop app. Download it on your Windows PC, Mac or Linux computer.
download.macNote: There is no download for Macs with an Intel processor.

whatsnew.label: New in v1.0
whatsnew.title: The build sequence as an app on your computer
whatsnew.desc: Monty IFC Viewer is now an app for Windows, macOS and Linux. You open several models in it, choose your own theme and language, and your IFC file stays on your own computer. The full list is in the release notes.

desktop.title: A real desktop app
desktop.desc: Installers for Windows, macOS and Linux, also as a .snap.

tabs.title: Several models in tabs
tabs.desc: Open several IFC files and switch between them.

colour.title: Colours by parameter
colour.desc: Elements get a colour based on the chosen parameter.

menu.title: Context menu
menu.desc: Isolate, hide and show all with the right mouse button.

themes.title: Themes and languages
themes.desc: Dark, light, blue or high contrast, in Dutch or English.

logo.title: New logo
logo.desc: In v1.0.2 the app got its new, approved logo.

price.q: What does Monty IFC Viewer cost?
price.a: Nothing. The viewer is free and open source, under the LGPL-3.0 licence. No subscription and no account.

sequence.q: How does the build sequence work?
sequence.a: You choose an IFC parameter, such as Mark. The viewer groups the elements per value and puts those values in order. Press play and the model grows step by step, at the pace you set.

privacy.q: Does my model go to a server?
privacy.a: No. The app reads the IFC file on your own computer. Nothing is uploaded.

mac.q: Does it work on a Mac?
mac.a: Yes, on a Mac with an Apple processor (M1 or newer). There is no download for Macs with an Intel processor.

keys.a: Space plays and pauses, the arrow keys go a step back or forward, Home and End jump to the first and last step, and Esc resets the view.

languages.q: Which languages and themes does the app offer?
languages.a: Dutch and English, with a dark, light, blue or high-contrast theme.

web.q: Is there a web version too?
web.a: A web version for sharing a model through a link is in development. To view your own IFC file now, use the app for Windows, macOS or Linux.

tech.heading: Technology
tech.sub: For those who want to know how it is built.

tauri.title: Tauri 2
tauri.desc: A thin native shell in Rust, with an installer of a few megabytes.

threejs.title: Three.js
threejs.desc: The 3D engine that brings the model to the screen interactively.

webifc.title: web-ifc
webifc.desc: Reads IFC files, as WebAssembly inside the app itself.
